summary: Rubico Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the closing of a public offering of 5,263,160 units, each consisting of one common share or pre-funded warrant plus one-and-a-half Class C warrants, at $0.95 per unit. Gross proceeds were approximately $5.0 million. The offering was made under an effective Form F-1 registration statement with Maxim Group LLC as sole placement agent. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring is involved. The filing serves to disclose the terms of the warrants and the offering's completion.
